id: 08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario
title: 飘带向外飘了
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario/src.py

points.K4: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
points.S1: 定向气流为什么要向内
points.S3: 报告负责人和设施人员

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门外，门框上一根小飘带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a laboratory door with a small ribbon tape hanging from the top of the door frame.
shots.narration: 这一课：门口的小飘带，在提醒什么？

shots.scene: 清晨，小研拎着包走到实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: Early morning light in a corridor; the female graduate student carrying a bag walks up to the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 一天早上，小研来实验室做实验。

shots.scene: 门一开，门框上的飘带向走廊方向飘出
shots.prompt_en: As the lab door opens, the ribbon tape on the door frame blows outward into the corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 一开门，飘带却朝走廊外面飘。

shots.scene: 从实验室指向走廊的蓝色气流箭头，带感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Blue airflow arrows pointing from the lab out into the corridor, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这说明空气正从实验室往外流。

shots.scene: 正常情况：气流箭头从走廊流进实验室，飘带向内飘，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Normal situation icon: blue airflow arrows flowing from the corridor into the lab, the ribbon tape bending inward, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 可正常情况下，气流应该流进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研停在门口，手扶门把，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops at the doorway with her hand on the handle, frowning.
shots.narration: 这时，该怎么办？

shots.scene: 阿杰从后面走来，想直接进门，被红叉图标挡住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks up behind her and tries to walk straight in; a red X icon appears in front of him.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：先进去干活吧。不行！

shots.section_title: 定向气流为什么要向内
shots.scene: 欣欣站在剖面示意图前，走廊、门、实验室，箭头向内
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a cutaway diagram of a corridor, a door and a lab, with airflow arrows pointing into the lab.
shots.narration: 定向气流，让空气从清洁区流向实验区。
overlay: 定向气流为什么要向内

shots.section_title: 定向气流为什么要向内
shots.scene: 实验室内的小雾点被向内的箭头挡在室内
shots.prompt_en: Tiny mist dots inside the lab are held back by inward-pointing airflow arrows at the door. No people.
shots.narration: 这样，室内的气溶胶就不会跑出来。

shots.section_title: 定向气流为什么要向内
shots.scene: 箭头反向，雾点飘向走廊，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The arrows reverse and the mist dots drift out into the corridor, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 飘带外飘，说明这道屏障失效了。

shots.scene: 小研退出门外，轻轻把门关上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps back into the corridor and gently closes the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 不进入，不开展任何实验，关好门。

shots.scene: 门上挂起一块空白的暂停使用提示牌，带禁止进入图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank notice board with a no entry pictogram hangs on the laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 门口挂牌，提醒别人也别进。

shots.scene: 如果已在室内：小人图标放下手中工作、盖好容器、离开
shots.prompt_en: Icon sequence: a person pictogram closes a container, steps away from the bench and exits through a door. No people.
shots.narration: 已经在里面，就收好材料，撤出关门。

shots.section_title: 报告负责人和设施人员
shots.scene: 小研打电话给老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the older man on her phone in the corridor.
shots.narration: 马上报告实验室负责人。
overlay: 报告负责人和设施人员

shots.section_title: 报告负责人和设施人员
shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱赶来，查看通风控制面板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives with a toolbox and checks a ventilation control panel with blank displays.
shots.narration: 通知设施人员，检查通风系统。

shots.section_title: 报告负责人和设施人员
shots.scene: 老李在空白记录本上写下发现时间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes the time of discovery in a blank maintenance logbook.
shots.narration: 说清发现时间、现象和位置。

shots.scene: 老李修好后，飘带重新向内飘
shots.prompt_en: After the repair, the ribbon tape on the door frame bends inward again while the facility engineer watches.
shots.narration: 修好后，先确认气流恢复向内。

shots.scene: 老周看过检查结果，摘下提示牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews the check results with the facility engineer and removes the notice from the door.
shots.narration: 负责人确认后，才能恢复实验。

shots.scene: 小研每次进门前抬头看一眼飘带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student glances up at the ribbon tape before entering the lab.
shots.narration: 以后每次进门，先看一眼飘带。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白的未遂事件登记表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank near miss report form.
shots.narration: 没人受伤，这是一起未遂事件。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上记录，小研在旁说明
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator fills in the blank report form while the female graduate student explains.
shots.narration: 也要登记上报，不能修好就算。

shots.scene: 闭环箭头：登记、查原因、整改、复查、分享
shots.prompt_en: A closed loop of five arrows with icons: a form, a magnifier, a wrench, a check mark, and a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 查原因、定措施、复查、全组分享。

shots.scene: 老李在通风设备上加装一个报警灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a small warning light on the ventilation control panel.
shots.narration: 比如加装报警，下次早发现。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现向内的气流箭头和飘带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of inward airflow arrows and a ribbon tape.
shots.narration: 气流应向内，飘带外飘就是异常。

shots.scene: 关门、挂牌、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a closed door, a no entry notice, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 不进入，关门挂牌，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 扳手、对勾、闭环箭头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a wrench, a green check, and a closed loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 修好验证再开工，未遂整改要闭环。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、老李在实验室门口挥手，飘带向内
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the facility engineer wave goodbye at the lab door, the ribbon tape bending inward.
shots.narration: 小飘带，大提醒，下次见！
